name: cursor
title: Cursor

files.text:
---
description: How to work in this Naive venture
alwaysApply: true
---

Read AGENTS.md at the venture root, and the AGENTS.md of each folder down to the one you work in, before writing anything. Write records through the router (node packages/naive/src/interfaces/cli/mentura.mjs), never by editing files, and never read _private/.

note: Cursor reads AGENTS.md and project rules in .cursor/rules/. The adapter adds one rule that always applies and points at the AGENTS.md chain.
